description: This file defines an enumeration MenuItemHighlightColors that provides color configurations for highlighting menu items, including a nested Palette struct, and functions to select primary and secondary colors based on highlight state.

classes.name: MenuItemHighlightColors
classes.description: An enum that contains color configuration logic for menu item highlights.

classes.name: Palette
classes.description: A struct within MenuItemHighlightColors that holds primary and secondary Color properties.

methods.name: primary
methods.description: Returns the primary color based on whether the menu item is highlighted.

methods.name: secondary
methods.description: Returns the secondary color with adjusted opacity if highlighted.

methods.name: palette
methods.description: Constructs and returns a Palette instance based on the highlight state.
